programmes.d: A rebellious young inductee has trouble toeing the line until he meets a retired officer's lovely daughter. James and his band are also drafted and decide to perk up their camp by putting on a big show.
A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.
Photographed and produced by both Jackson Leighter...and his wife...and, while not wishing to disillusion those who state this has only been seen at film festivals, this clinker of a ...

Smugglers hijack the Mesquiteers truck, but the police catch up, kill the smugglers, and then try to arrest the Mesquiteers as part of the gang. They escape but now have to prove their innocence while being hunted as wanted men.
On a spooky island, three stranded travelers find an evil doctor working with foreign spies and in control of zombies.

The story of a family in Tokyo who live under the same roof in a large house and include the widowed sixty-year-old mother, older son and his wife, the youngest daughter and the older daughter who, while being married, is experiencing domestic problems and has moved back in.
An unassuming office worker is arrested and stands trial, but he is never made aware of his charges.

Dr. Markoff is a mad scientist with an evil plan and his victim is a famous concert pianist. He develops a formula that spreads an acromegaly virus, which causes extension of bones and distortion of facial features.
A cowboy escorts a little girl, whose mother made her the heir of a cash-able oil company, and must protect her from an outlaw as they search for the girl's father.
Nancy Drew, reporter for the school newspaper, clears a girl of murder charges.
Bob Gordon comes from a rich background but wants make it on his own. He dreams of becoming a newspaper reporter and he eventually gets his chance.
Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.
Fumiko struggles to get her literary work published, spending years working in poverty while being abused by her boyfriend all the while hoping to break free from the cycle.
Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father.

Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

American film noir from 1954. In a small sleepy town with an unusual name Suddenly there are bloodcurdling events. Three gangsters attack the Benson family and bond them in their own house. The building is located on the top of a hill near the railroad station, next to which a train with the President of the United States is going to pass.

programmes.t: La Vie aventureuse de Jack London
programmes.d: Episodes in the adventurous life of the American novelist (1876-1916).
The family of an older man who runs a small sake brewery become concerned with his finances and his health after they discover him visiting an old mistress from his youth.
A trucker framed for murder breaks out of jail, takes a young woman hostage, and enters her sports car in cross-border road race hoping to get to Mexico before the police catch him.
A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.
Thousands of foreign workers support today the most known Italian excellence: agri-food production. A docu-musical shows their daily exploitation.
The unhistorical adventures of pirate Captain Kidd revolve around treasure and treachery.
Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.
With little luck at keeping a job in the city a New Yorker tries work in the country and eventually finds his way leading a herd of cattle to the West Coast.

This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programmes.t: Le médecin dément de l'île de sang
programmes.d: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.
In 1940, a concentration-camp escapee assumes the identity of a dead British officer, only to become a prisoner of war.

When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.
A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.
A prostitute newly arrived in the South Pacific finds herself at odds with a stern missionary determined to save her soul.
Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.
A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.
Father hires a woman to lure his son away from a gold digger.
A town's corrupt officials think a fool is actually an investigator in disguise.

One of the best film-noir and American productions directed by Fritz Lang. Chris Cross, a young man who works as a bank cashier, meets the beautiful and passionate Kitty. He wants to help her and falls in love with the girl. This feeling draws upon him a series of disasters.
A group of down-on-their-luck workers combine their abilities to make a Gallafentian-style commune... and bread!
A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.
Sociopath criminal masterminds armored car robbery.
An independent former ranch foreman is kidnapped along with an heiress, who is being held for ransom by trio of ruthless outlaws.
A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.
When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.
The twin of a kindly small-town physician returns from the grave for vengeance against his brother, who secretly killed him because the twin served Satan.
Four soldiers trapped behind enemy lines must confront their fears and desires.
Andy Hardy goes to college after returning from World War II. He is in love with Kay Wilson this time.
A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.
A film about place and belonging.
A Ukrainian village must suddenly contend with the German invasion of June 1941.
A naive young girl, looking to escape from a bad family situation, falls in love with a man who turns out to be a cad, and leads her down the road to ruin.
The beautiful Anna Neagle stars as a circus performer who falls in love with a rich car dealer's son, against her family's wishes. Features some spirited dance numbers with Ray Bolger.
Murdered young women have finger severed off.

A full-length documentary, which is a record of an extraordinary, long-term relationship of a middle-aged artist with his aged neighbor. A lonely, solitary old lady with a wicked sense of humor turns out to be a great companion and a perfect partner for conversations for a man in his forties. Discussions conducted by these people who are so different from each other, interrupted and picked up again over the years, are the heart of this personal, warm and surprising movie.
A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.
Nancy Drew, reporter for the school newspaper, clears a girl of murder charges.

programmes.t: New Voices in an Old Flower
programmes.d: Westerners generally view Ethiopia as the mythical land of Rastafarians. However, the contemporary music scene is much richer than that, as this sultry, nocturnal exploration of the capital Addis Abeba demonstrates. From reggae to hip-hop and from free jazz to electronic sampling: diversity rules.
Disguised as a priest, an escaped convict makes his way to Texas. He ends up in a small rural town where the townsfolk mistake him for their new church minister.
Sociopath criminal masterminds armored car robbery.
The love story of a couple which, after the marriage and the birth of the first son, turns into hell. Taken from the novel Rispondimi by Susanna Tamaro.
The invention of a machine that can cause remote explosions brings the attention of Scotland Yard and Bulldog Drummond.
A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

A dim-witted busboy finds acclaim as an artist for a plaster-covered dead cat that is mistaken as a skillful statuette. The desire for more praise soon leads to an increasingly deadly series of works.

Nutsa lives with her two small children in suburb of Tblissi, Georgia. With her Goga, they would bee today a regular family if he hadn't been arrested. Between the wedding in prison and the monthly visits, a routine sets in. Wil they be able to overcome this double reality?
A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.

Single mum (father of child dead) from the country with 6th grade boy comes to Tokyo, leaves the boy to live with his uncle's family - wife, male, female teens, run a struggling greengrocer - and lives/ works in local inn.
Hoppy goes undercover as an Eastern gambler to rein in the fraternal perpetrators of a cattle-rustling scheme.
When a 19-year-old Cora returns to her childhood town she gets involved in an expected course of events which will reveal a crime committed by some of the locals a few decades ago.
French police inspector Maigret investigates the murder of a rich Paris widow and ends up chasing the killer up the Eiffel Tower's girders.
Thousands of foreign workers support today the most known Italian excellence: agri-food production. A docu-musical shows their daily exploitation.

programmes.st: up, the Story of a Woman
programmes.d: A successful nightclub singer weds a struggling songwriter, but when his fame eclipses hers, she delves into alcoholism.
Bob Gordon comes from a rich background but wants make it on his own. He dreams of becoming a newspaper reporter and he eventually gets his chance.
A romance novelist appoints a would-be writer as his secretary. Although she is initially dismayed by his work ethic and playboy attitude, they begin to fall in love.
A teenager lands in a brutal reform school for refusing to squeal on his bootlegger boss.
Two goofy entertainers meet a mad scientist on a jungle island.
Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl.
An 8 year old Bolivian boy gets lost on the streets of La Paz, hundreds of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before he sets out in an emotive journey to find his lost father.
Parole officers fight gangsters trying to break into system.
At dinner a record is played and the host's message alleges that all the people present are guilty of murder and suddenly the first of them is dead, then the next.
A chemical manufacturer is killed just after asking detective James Wong to help him. So Detective Wong decides to investigate this as well as two subsequent murders.

Whilst travelling on business, successful young lawyer John Mason meets and instantly falls in love with a stranger, a beautiful woman named Jane. The two get married the following day, but their honeymoon goes downhill when they encounter strong disapproval from John's mother and his domineering boss.
A chorus girl's career is ruined and her brother is driven to suicide when she starts smoking marijuana.
A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.
Four young adults in Fort McMurray, AB, struggle to deal with the consequences of their actions and how it affects their friends and families.

A journey through memory accompanied by Buñuel's photographs taken during the scouting of locations for "Nazarín", as well as the ones made by Manuel Álvarez Bravo during the shooting of the film, along with the testimonies and reflections of artists, filmmakers and intellectuals like Luis Eduardo Aute, Jean Claude Carrière, Carlos Reygadas, Silvia Pinal, Arturo Ripsetein or Carlos Saura among many others, to re-discover the poetic, vivid and inspiring force of Buñuel's cinematography.
A cowboy escorts a little girl, whose mother made her the heir of a cash-able oil company, and must protect her from an outlaw as they search for the girl's father.
In early 19th century New England, an attractive unscrupulous woman uses her beauty and wits to deceive and control the men around her.
Abbott & Costello search for diamonds in Africa, along the way meeting a visually-impaired gunner, a hungry lion, and a tribe of cannibals...

A musical documentary, presenting the contemporary and historical rhythms of Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia. Sounds, characteristic for this part of Africa, come from the mountains and desert regions, from the wilderness and the city. During almost an hour and a half of music travel, the viewer has the opportunity to get to know the rich cultural heritage of Ethiopia.

A convicted thief in Dartmoor prison hides the location of the stolen Bank of England printing plates inside three music boxes. When the innocent purchasers of the boxes start to be murdered, Holmes and Watson investigate.
A man tries passing off a socially awkward fellow as a Casanova in the hopes of marrying off his would be sister-in-law.
Burlesque star (Blaine) makes it in the big time.
An English village is occupied by disguised German paratroopers as an advance post for a planned invasion.

programmes.t: Sous le plus petit chapiteau du monde
programmes.d: A young broke couple inherits an old cinema from a deceased uncle. Hoping this could be a great turn of events in their favour, they travel to Sloughborough to see if they can sell it for some extra money. But what they encounter there is barely a barely standing building of The Flea Pit cinema run by three eccentrics who don't seem to care.
Detective tries to solve the murder of antiques collector who was in possession of a famous jewel known as "The Eye of the Daugther of The Moon.".

It's the start of WWII in Northern Australia. The Japanese are getting close. People are evacuating and burning everything in a "scorched earth" policy. Rather than kill all their cattle, a disparate group decides to drive them overland half way across the continent.

However, the contemporary music scene is much richer than that, as this sultry, nocturnal exploration of the capital Addis Abeba demonstrates. From reggae to hip-hop and from free jazz to electronic sampling: diversity rules.

When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause.
When Captain Street's best friend Dan Grady is murdered, Street receives help from Chinese detective James Lee Wong and local newspaper reporter Bobbie Logan.
Escaped criminal "The Fox" hates Hoppy and a Rurales colonel for imprisoning him and lures Cassidy to Mexico in order to exact his vengeance.
Two men find an abandoned baby and fight over the ownership of the child resulting in lifelong rivalry.

Count Karl Ulysses von Salis-Marschlins was a Swiss botanist and naturalist. He travelled widely observing and studying the lands he visited. In 1789 he travelled in the Kingdom of Naples. On returning home, he wrote a book about it. Here is how he described his visit to the "Casino del Duca" at San Basilio, the largest estate of Apulia, South Italy. "Anapeson" are these places, now, sleepless and abandoned within the distracted modernity. The History as ruins.

The local school is causing Hoppy problems. First Bar 20 cattle are stolen when Hoppy investigates a problem there. Then the new teacher arrives and disrupts the routine of the Bar 20 hands. Later with the Bar 20 hands at graduation, the rustlers are poised to strike again. But there is dissension among them and this will lead to the break that Hoppy needs.

programmes.t: Wake Me When the War Is Over
programmes.d: During the final months of WW2, a lonely German Baroness hides an attractive American airman in her mansion for long time without telling him the war has been over for almost five years.

In one Paris divided militarily into two like was the former Berlin Est-Ouest, Ines Raymond receives from the right bank people who ask for a visa for the left bank. Each have their reasons and dreams for crossing the Seine, but, Ines must follow the new instructions.
Ronnie Jackson is an amateur detective wrongly convicted for murder. Is there a way for Ronnie to solve the mystery and save himself from a death sentence?
Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.
A romance novelist appoints a would-be writer as his secretary. Although she is initially dismayed by his work ethic and playboy attitude, they begin to fall in love.
To make her lover jealous, a beautiful socialite passes off a bumbling plumber as her paramour.

programmes.t: The Plague at the Karatas Village
programmes.d: A new mayor comes to the remote village Karatas. A very strange illness reins over here. However somebody is used to live with it and says this is a simple flu.
A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.
A little squirrel with lots of charm accidentally helps two poor, down-but-NOT-out families overcome their obstacles.
Young female models are being strangled. Will law enforcement be able to stop the crime wave before more women become victims?
The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical step down memory lane, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this vehicle for their excellent music.

The story of a family in Tokyo who live under the same roof in a large house and include the widowed sixty-year-old mother, older son and his wife, the youngest daughter and the older daughter who, while being married, is experiencing domestic problems and has moved back in.
Young Sherry Williams dreams of having a singing career, and she idolizes her older sister Josephine, who has gone to New York to perform on the stage. When Sherry is distraught just before...

programmes.t: La Vie aventureuse de Jack London
programmes.d: Episodes in the adventurous life of the American novelist (1876-1916).
After a traumatic accident, a woman becomes drawn to a mysterious abandoned carnival.
Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

An insurance salesman arrives at a creepy mansion to discover his potential eccentric millionaire client already dead. Instead he gets embroiled in a house full of greedy, murderous relatives competing for the inheritance.
Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) comes to the rescue of the railroad when a land baron and his gang try to prevent its construction.
The relationship between Javier and Anna runs out of gas. She hits the brakes and Javier is dragged by inertia until he learns to get over it.
Two rivaling radio producers try to get the same sponsor. So they try to overtop each other with new ideas.
A scatterbrained socialite hires a vagrant as a family butler - but there's more to Godfrey than meets the eye.
A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

It's summertime and Jasmin's foster family is preparing to go on a trip. Everyone is waiting impatiently for it, but not a girl. Jasmin wants to spend time with her real mum Eva, who is back after serving a long prison term. After a quarrel with her foster parents, Jasmin runs away and persuades Eva to leave together to the countryside.

Frederick Henry is a American architect serving for the Italian Army as an ambulance driver during World War I. During a bombarding raid he meets British nurse Catherine Barkley who serves for the Red Cross. A romance develops between the two fast, but the question is can it last in the midst of a terrible war.
WWII Burma... Six paratroopers undertake an extremely dangerous mission against the Japanese. It will ultimately cost them their lives, except for one "lucky" survivor.
A professor gets mixed up with chorus girls in a Broadway musical.
A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding, and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.
The life of the poor Tucker family who worked as cotton pluggers and decided to get their own ground, but nature was against them.
A young woman is seduced by a charismatic highwayman who offers her promises of fame as a singer in exchange for romance.

Rival newspaper reporters Pat Morgan and Ted Rand find themselves unraveling the mystery behind the death of a millionaire philanthropist who fell from his penthouse balcony. When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.
Five thirty-something men in as many separate segments struggle to grapple with the relentless absurdity of their respective existences.
Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programmes.t: Les produits de beauté de Ginza
programmes.d: A luckless geisha struggles to make a living for herself and her young son.

Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.
A trucker framed for murder breaks out of jail, takes a young woman hostage, and enters her sports car in cross-border road race hoping to get to Mexico before the police catch him.
A mentally-disturbed spinster experiences a series of bizarre encounters in Rome as she searches for someone she feels she'll know--when she finds him.
Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programmes.t: Règlement de comptes à Abilene Town
programmes.d: A sheriff tries to stop homesteader conflicts in the West after the Civil War.
Two goofy entertainers meet a mad scientist on a jungle island.
When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.
Two narcotics agents go after a gang of murderous drug dealers who use ships docking at the New York harbor to smuggle in their contraband.
Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.
The true story of Carlson's Raiders and their World War II attack on Makin Island.

A fictionalized biopic of composer Jerome Kern, portrayed by Robert Walker, follows Kern's rise to the top on Broadway and in Hollywood, and features an all-star cast including Frank Sinatra, Judy Garland, and Lena Horne.
The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

One of the best film-noir and American productions directed by Fritz Lang. Chris Cross, a young man who works as a bank cashier, meets the beautiful and passionate Kitty. He wants to help her and falls in love with the girl. This feeling draws upon him a series of disasters.

Set in post-war Japan, The Lady of Musashino tells the story of Michiko, a disillusioned young woman trapped in a loveless marriage. She confides in her younger cousin, Tsutomo, and the two become close.

In a small house, in the middle of the imposing Patagonia, lives Casimira (80), an old woman with a kind look who spends her days in the middle of the different tasks of the field. Her daily life becomes difficult and she must ask for help with some tasks, but in spite of everything she will maintain her independence with conviction and will start with one last challenge.
Robespierrre, a powerful figure in the French revolution, is desperately looking for his black book, a death list of those marked for the guillotine.
Andy Hardy goes to college after returning from World War II. He is in love with Kay Wilson this time.

Follow the escapades of Dr. Robert Morgan, the last survivor of a plague that turned all of humanity into the living dead. Morgan spends his days killing the creatures, and during the night he locks himself inside his house. His life will change after he encounters a contaminated woman named Ruth Collins.
An undercover agent for the government is sent to round up a gang of counterfeiters operating near the Mexican border.
An introvert city teenager is sent to his father's limber ranch. While trying to figure out his place as the son of the boss he finds himself in a world packed with naturalized violence.

Chet Kasedon is after the Indians hidden gold mine but Chief Moya will not reveal it's location. He has also hired mining engineers Gale and Mortimer to locate the mine. When Gale sees Kasedon's cruelty to Moya, he switches sides.
Drummond has to leave for Morocco on his wedding day with his fiancee and trusted friends to rescue his friend Nielsen who is kidnapped by an international criminal.
A young girl wakes up one morning to find that she has turned completely blue.

Captain Gerard, greatest lover in the Foreign Legion, is assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and find out what he can about the emir's activities. Gerard enjoys his work with lovely Cara, but arrives to find rebellion brewing.
A champion boxer on the lamb, believed to have committed murder while drunk, takes refuge and finds redemption at a farm for delinquent youths.
A romance novelist appoints a would-be writer as his secretary. Although she is initially dismayed by his work ethic and playboy attitude, they begin to fall in love.
Police lieutenant Sam Carson investigates a political murder after the victim is dumped at the door of police headquarters.
A brash young midget car race driver lives in the shadow of his famous father, a drunken womanizer, who was killed in an accident years earlier.
After one member of their group is murdered, the performers at a burlesque house must work together to find out who the killer is before they strike again.
Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.
Abbott & Costello search for diamonds in Africa, along the way meeting a visually-impaired gunner, a hungry lion, and a tribe of cannibals...
Ex-WAVE encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.
Newly married Kay Dunstan announces that she and her husband are having a baby, leaving her father to come to grips with the fact that he will soon be a granddad.
A man returns to his Appalachian homestead. On the trip, he falls for a young woman. The only problem is her family has vowed to kill every member of his family.
First-time filmmaker Hervé Lasgouttes puts an aimless young man to the test in a crime-tinged romance set on the stormy Brittany coast.

John Wayne explodes across the screen in this action-packed tale of deceit - and revenge. In a dilapidated ghost town, John Blair (Wayne) runs afoul of the villainous Drake who attempts to cheat him out of a lucrative mail delivery contract. It all leads to a thrilling race in the gorgeous Sacramento Valley. Stagecoach Run has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time!

programmes.t: Qui a tué l'ours en peluche
programmes.d: In New York, a disco hostess is stalked by a sexual predator and she requests help from a vice squad detective who takes a personal interest in the case.
